raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions derives txn_date from CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE), and every batch's ingest_ts falls on the day after its txn_ts, so all 4600 POSTED rows fail the date-consistency check. txn_date should be the transaction date, so deriving it from txn_ts fixes the silver layer and the gold tables rebuild from it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
